summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting amendments to an inventory finance agreement between Boxlight Corp. and J.J. Astor Co., a related party. The amendments convert portions of outstanding debt into common stock: $75,608.38 into 30,290 shares on August 17, 2026, and $92,357.55 into 37,000 shares on August 19, 2026, both at $2.49615 per share. The transactions are routine debt conversions, not a special situation such as an acquisition or tender. The chairman, Michael Pope, is CEO of J.J. Astor, creating a related-party aspect. No deal terms beyond conversion price and shares are material to special-situations analysis.
